text:
ci-bot: [ALERT] Canary deploy 2026-03-17T08:42Z - inference-api-canary experiencing 5xx spike after image pull. Registry reported layer digest mismatch.
laura: seeing 503s for the canary route, paging oncall. logs: 
```
E0317 08:42:11 server.go:142] mount failed: response: {"errors":[{"code":"BLOB_UNKNOWN","message":"blob unknown to registry"}]}
```
sam: looking. running `registryctl ls-tags redwood/prod-inference --digest staging-20260317`
sam: output: `staging-20260317 -> sha256:deadbeef` and mirror-sync job shows `sha256:baadf00d` for pushed layer — looks like a mirror race, stale layer returned from mirror cache :thinking_face:
alex: if mirror returned an old layer that doesn't match manifest, kube pulls fail and app returns 5xx. recommend immediate mitigation: disable new canary traffic and flip feature flag.
laura: agreed — toggling canary route to baseline and invoking kill-switch for the new inference route. Eve, can you confirm customer impact?
eve: support: ~24 requests failed in last 10m, mostly internal test traffic and ~6 customers on the canary bucket. No PII exposed. Raising incident with severity S2.
laura: ops command: `/ops feature-toggle inference-v2 false --env prod --reason "canary image digest mismatch"`
opsbot: ✅ feature inference-v2 set to false (actor: laura) :white_check_mark:
release-bot: Starting rollback: rolling inference-api-canary to previous image `prod-inference:20260310` across canary nodes. Tracking rollout id: r-20260317-0810
laura: also adding image pullguard to prevent mirror fallback: `kubectl set env ds/pullguard MIRROR_FALLBACK=false` on infra nodes.
sam: confirmed registry mirror had a concurrent `mirror-sync` job at 08:41 that overwrote a tag while new manifest was being pushed — root cause appears to be race in CI mirror step + eventual consistency of mirror cache.
alex: can we bubble this up to CI pipeline owners and add a pre-push digest lock? I can open a quick PR to fail fast on manifest/digest mismatch.
sam: yeah I'll draft the change and add a registry-lock step in the pipeline.
eve: customers impacted: emailed 6 accounts with temporary errors, support playbook run. No escalations yet.
laura: monitoring: error rate back down to baseline after rollback. rolling back to stable completed at 08:50Z.
release-bot: Rollback complete (r-20260317-0810) — canary traffic cut.
laura: creating incident ticket (INC-20260317-47) and assigning to eng-infra + ci-team. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-20260317-47
alex: action items: (1) add registry digest-lock in CI, (2) add mirror-sync mutex, (3) add manifest preflight check in deployer, (4) postmortem in 48h.
sam: I will own #1 and #2. laura please own #4.
laura: ack. tagging runbook: infra/runbooks/registry-retag.md and ci/runbooks/manifest-check.md.
ci-bot: Incident created and paged oncall rotation. cc: eng-infra.
laura: thanks team. follow up doc and postmortem after incident. :thumbsup:
